Evidence / VIS-POS-VALUE
Evidence record
When was it measured or observed?Mar-2025–Jan-2026; Sep-2025 gap

Nominal value of reported POS transactions, monthly

01What does this evidence establish?

The nominal value of POS transactions reported by the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) rose from YER 320 million in March 2025 to YER 1,262 million in January 2026, within CBY-Aden's reporting scope. The September 2025 value is missing because no verified value is available for that month. The series is nominal and does not establish real-value growth, purchasing-power change, unique-user growth or financial-inclusion impact.

Another view of the evidence
01What does this evidence establish?02What does it measure?03Who or what does it apply to?04How current is it?05What this evidence does not establish06Original source and verification07Method and verification detail

02What does it measure?

The monthly nominal value, in Yemeni rials, of POS transactions reported by the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) within its reporting scope, March 2025 to January 2026, with no value for September 2025.

03Who or what does it apply to?

Nominal value of POS transactions within the payment-system reporting scope of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden); how far that scope covers each area of Yemen is not established.

04How current is it?

The latest observation in this record refers to January 2026; the series runs monthly from March 2025, with no value for September 2025. January 2026 was the latest monthly POS release on the payments page of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) when checked on 26 September 2026. The figures should not be read as describing a later period unless a newer comparable release is published.

05What this evidence does not establish

The values are nominal rials: they do not show real growth, a change in purchasing power, more users or an effect on financial inclusion, and no inflation-adjusted series is established here. September 2025 has no verified value, and none is interpolated. The totals fall within the reporting scope of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) and are not shown to cover all of Yemen.

Limits of the measure

From July 2025 the monthly releases take the form of a one-page infographic; continuity of the reporting scope across that change has not been verified.

07Method and verification detail

Detail for reproducing or challenging this record without changing what it means.

How was it produced?

Monthly values in Yemeni rials as published in the monthly POS releases of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden), normalised to millions of rials; the values are nominal and are not adjusted for inflation or exchange-rate changes. No value is available for September 2025, and none is interpolated. Each value is shown to the nearest million rials (for example, 317.639 million is shown as 318).

When does this record change?

This record is updated when an authoritative source is revised or replaced, a newer comparable observation becomes available, the definition, population or method changes, or the conditions for public use change.

How can I verify it?

This record is drawn from the source(s) listed on this page. Open a source record to reach the original document, and check that the definition, period, population and geography match what is stated here.

How should this record be read?

Read this evidence within the definition, population or group covered, calculation base where relevant, period, geography and method shown on the page. Before reusing or comparing it, check the source, limitations, evidence date and correction history. If a value or source link is unavailable, the page says so rather than filling the gap by inference. This resource does not host source files; where an original-source link is given, check the publisher’s terms before republishing.
